title: MCP server changes a tool description
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: The case-store MCP server is upgraded and one tool description changes wording.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: Signed or allowlisted descriptions (C-14) were attested against the previous manifest. A tool description is also text the model reads, so a changed description is a vector for instruction injection (C-12) and the RAG poisoning pack no longer covers the current surface.
